subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu add a supported inbound media suppression configuration, and what contract should that setting use?
rationale: Current OpenClaw has no documented `ignoreFileContent` key, so fixing this means adding or formalizing plugin configuration semantics rather than repairing an already-defined contract.

options.title: Add Feishu-owned suppression
options.body: Add a documented Feishu config such as an account-inheritable inbound media suppression option, with placeholder behavior and tests for files, rich posts, audio, and other media.

options.title: Keep current media behavior
options.body: Treat Feishu file/media download as the intended default and guide users to lower media/tool limits instead of adding another channel config knob.

options.title: Defer for live repro
options.body: Wait for a live Feishu proof run before deciding whether the source-proven path is causing unacceptable context pressure in real deployments.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu-owned suppression
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu config such as an account-inheritable inbound media suppression option, with placeholder behavior and tests for files, rich posts, audio, and other media.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the declared Feishu plugin community owner, so they are the best available owner for channel-specific config semantics.
